standard_prerequisites.name: The behaviour of depth under a flat local homomorphism, together with the formal fibre formula
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source lines 2585-2593 and attributed to a lemma of another chapter (a cross-chapter pointer)
standard_prerequisites.use: Splits the depth of the completion into the depth of the original module and the depth of the formal fibre.

standard_prerequisites.name: The Cohen-Macaulay property of the formal fibres of a Noetherian ring with a dualizing complex, and the equality of dimensions of a local ring and its completion
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 2594-2601 and 2617-2620) as cross-chapter pointers, the first with a reference to a further chapter of more algebra
standard_prerequisites.use: Replaces the depth of the formal fibre by its dimension and identifies the two dimension terms appearing in the displayed chain of equalities.

core_obligations: Split the depth: the proof computes the depth of the completed module over the completed ring as the sum of the depth of the original module and the depth of the formal fibre, which is at least the original depth by flatness (proof lines 2585-2593)

Replace depth by dimension: since the formal fibres are Cohen-Macaulay, the depth of the formal fibre equals its dimension, which converts the sum into the form used in the second display (proof lines 2594-2601)

Rewrite the sum: the proof then rewrites the sum of the two dimension terms as the dimension of the localisation of the quotient by the prime over the completed ring, using that the completion is catenary (proof lines 2603-2617)

Identify with the original expression: the two remaining dimension terms agree because the rings in question have the same ideal-adic completions, which is the cross-chapter dimension statement (proof lines 2617-2620)
proof_roadmap: 由平坦性 depth(M'_{p'}) = depth(M_p) + depth(A'_{p'}/pA'_{p'}) ≥ depth(M_p)（跨章引理）。
形式纤维 Cohen-Macaulay（dualizing 章）故上式第二项等于其维数；再用 A' 是 catenary 把和改写成 dim((A'/pA')_{q'})，最后用 (A/p)_q 与 (A'/pA')_{q'} 有相同 I-进完成（more on algebra 引理）得到与原式相等。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement compares the depth of a finite module at a prime of a Noetherian ring having a dualizing complex with the depth of its completion at a prime lying over it, proving an inequality and an equality for the sum of the depth and the dimension of the quotient (author lemma at source lines 2562-2582, label lemma-change-completion). The proof (source lines 2584-2621) uses the flatness of the completion to split off the formal fibre, the Cohen-Macaulay property of the formal fibres to replace the depth of that fibre by its dimension, and the catenary property together with the equality of the ideal-adic completions of the two dimension quotients to identify the resulting expression with the original one (proof lines 2603-2620). The chain of rewritings of the depth-dimension sum is the content. H2.
